svg.text: Every SA is scoped to its job: pipeline may only touch its BigQuery dataset slice + Vertex AI; eval-runner may additionally invoke

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the pipeline service; the scheduler may only start the eval-runner job. No service-account keys anywhere; no project-level owner/editor.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The cloud-spend numbers the agent reasons about are a small, deterministic SYNTHETIC fixture (spend_data.py) — a demo dataset, not live billing data.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: eval_scores has 20 days of SYNTHETIC seed history (is_synthetic=true) so the trend chart has more than one point on day one, plus real judged runs (is_synthetic=false).

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Every Gemini call, every guardrail decision, and every token/cost/latency figure is Captured/Live — the pipeline makes real, billed Vertex AI calls.
